note: Thresholds from docs/plans/mpc-chopping.md section 9.3. A change needs a written reason in docs/plans/mpc-chopping-measurements.md. cases is '*' or a list of matrix case names; requires lists footage and/or dialogue; boundsByCase overrides bounds for one case. The master criteria apply to nofilm with its own loudness window (C-M1, C-M3, C-M5); true peak, limiter, glue, pumping and soft-clip bounds are the same on every case. C-D8's motifFractionMin: motif mode places pieces on the beat grid by design, so a lower share clears the kicks (docs/mix-verification.md).

criteria.description: Integrated loudness -13.0 to -11.0 LUFS on ref; -14.0 to -10.5 on the other film cases; -14.5 to -12.0 on nofilm (music only: the fixed master calibration reads about 1.4 LU under ref without the film)
True peak at most -1.0 dBTP (ffmpeg) and at most -0.9 dBTP by the 16x reconstruction
PLR 9 to 12.5 dB (below 8 fails); 9 to 14 dB on nofilm (the same peaks over about 1.4 LU less loudness)
Short-term maximum at most -8.5 LUFS; PSR at least 6 dB
Master crest 9 to 13 dB; 9 to 14.5 dB on nofilm (music only, about 1.4 LU quieter at the same ceiling)
Limiter reduction: mean at most 3.0 dB, p95 at most 5.0 dB, maximum at most 8.0 dB, above 3 dB for at most 10 percent of the time (engine trace, else the inferred gain trace)
Glue reduction: p95 at most 3 dB, mean 0.3 to 2.0 dB (engine trace)
Pumping index at most 0.8 dB; kick-synchronous dip at most 1.5 dB
Soft clip engaged on at most 3 percent of samples (engine trace)
Correlation below 120 Hz at least 0.8; full band at least 0.3; mono loss at most 3 LU
Energy below 25 Hz at least 50 dB under the total; tilt -3 to -6.5 dB per octave
LRA 2 to 9 LU
In 20 to 120 Hz each of mids, lead, space, dialogue, bed is at least 12 dB under the louder of drums and bass

Aligned bass accents, measured from the audio (-6 dB rise of the 40-160 Hz envelope, bass stem against drum stem): median |lag| at most 5 ms, p90 at most 12 ms; kick plus bass sum at least -1 dB (median) and -3 dB (worst) against the louder part; duck depth 1.5 to 4.5 dB
Bass 60 to 250 Hz within -6 to +3 dB of drums in that band; bass 150 to 800 Hz at most 18 dB under its 40 to 150 Hz fundamental band
Drum bus crest 10 to 14 dB; peak at most -3 dBFS before the master; kick attack time at most 1.2 times the unprocessed take (needs landmarks)
Mids 3 to 8 dB under the lead when both play; mids at least 3 dB over the lead in lead rests where mids play; at least two mid articulations per 16 bars
Return salience at least +6 dB against mids, space and bed and not below the theme phrase's; no chop under the first two return notes; theme and return onset correlation at least 0.8; same program
Space at least 3 dB under the lead in lead-active phrases

SII proxy mean at least 0.55 and p10 at least 0.40 over featured chops (merged, 0.5 s or more) and over every dry piece of 0.12 s or more; 1 to 4 kHz SNR mean at least +3 dB (aim +6); per-chop loudness spread at most 2.5 LU

Bed keeps its baseline effected character (wet at least equal to direct); audibility index in gaps 0.10 to 0.55; bed at least 10 dB under the music plus chops in gaps; bed at least 6 dB under dialogue in 1 to 4 kHz during chops
Routing identities hold (stems sum to the Lo-Fi bus and to the pre-master within 2e-6)

Lead salience in every phrase: over the first 400 ms of every lead note in 500 Hz to 4 kHz, the lead is under the dialogue for at most 45 percent of notes, and the median lead minus the power sum of all other sections is at least -4 dB
Every consecutive pair of 16-bar windows with dialogue differs by at least 0.25
Family or bank changes at least every 8 bars (plan log; without it, consecutive 8-bar windows must differ)
Consecutive blocks are not identical apart from declared repeats
An empty bar in every 8; nothing in the last 2 beats before an 8-bar boundary; occupancy at most 0.55 per 8 bars (grammar mode only; skipped in motif mode, see C-D9)
No overlapping dry events

Stage timing total p95 at most 2000 ms and maximum 3000 ms; every committed event at least 0.30 s ahead, with the commit placed by the live-order simulation (analysis starts the live scheduling lead before the bed, committed after the measured wall time). scripts/perf-run.sh --lofi is the live gate
The first two statements of a hook are the same pad and transform

At least 90 percent of accents are 50 ms or more from a kick attack in grammar mode; at least 50 percent in motif mode, whose pieces sit on the beat and eighth grid by design (statements on downbeats), where the take's kicks also sit

Motif mode: every bar of every 16-bar loop has a chop onset; the full line plays at most twice per loop; at least 60 percent of events are sub-line pieces; every loop has repeat-stutter and split-with-pause cells; occupancy 0.30 to 0.62
